_about: T1242 (owner 2026-11-27): the loops the map build never removes BY NAME. Loop removal runs in the atlas before any rule applies; a loop is not kept because a rule, park, reserve or licence happens to land on it. Kept only: the waters listed here (a book row or DFO place names them, or the owner keeps them), loops that touch a lake, and loops a gauge, tidal limit, curated cut or owner call names (worked out in the build). A listed blue line the atlas no longer has stops the build. Considered and NOT listed (stretches of a main river, not channels): Fraser at Lillooet's tailrace channel, Babine 'Rainbow Alley', Kitimat west half, the John Hart channel below Ladore Dam. Add a row to keep a loop; delete one to let it go. Each row: water, blks (blue-line keys), why, id, words (the book's or DFO's printed text, whole; the owner's words for his rows), date, and optionally reading (the parsed row); the build and check_curated refuse an unknown key.
